local root = workspace.Phase1Map
local st = workspace.SpawnTown
local op = OverlapParams.new(); op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include; op.FilterDescendantsInstances = {st}
local out, bad = {}, {}
local n = 0
for _, aname in ipairs({'town1', 'town1_extra', 'town1_yard'}) do
  local a = root:FindFirstChild(aname)
  local c = 0
  if a then
    for _, m in ipairs(a:GetDescendants()) do
      if m:IsA('Model') and m:GetAttribute('PlanKey') then
        local cf, sz = m:GetBoundingBox()
        local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf, sz * 0.8, op)
        local solid = 0
        for _, h in ipairs(hits) do if h.CanCollide and h.Transparency < 0.9 and h.Size.Magnitude > 4 then solid += 1 end end
        if solid > 0 then c += 1; table.insert(bad, m:GetAttribute('PlanKey') .. ' ' .. m.Name .. ' hits ' .. hits[1]:GetFullName():gsub('Workspace.SpawnTown.', '')) end
        n += 1; if n % 100 == 0 then task.wait() end
      end
    end
  end
  table.insert(out, aname .. ' overlapping old buildings: ' .. c)
end
return table.concat(out, '\n') .. '\n' .. table.concat(bad, '\n', 1, math.min(#bad, 40))
